671:t_115:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We won't be stopped by words like that! We've already started running toward the future!」

671:t_116:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Isn't loving someone about understanding each other!?」

671:t_116:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you live that much for love, why do you spread your ego everywhere!?」

671:t_116:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Truth... $$シンカ$$... So you really are the one leading the way toward it.」

671:t_116:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「Are you talking about the power of an $$イノベイター$$!?」

671:t_116:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That power is merely a means! If you can't even understand that, you still have a long way to go, Wingless!」

671:t_116:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Before you meet a future of despair, I will grant you all destruction!」

671:t_116:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「No! You rejected understanding each other. You're my enemy... our enemy!」

671:t_116:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「We'll go beyond you and move forward! That is our mission!」

671:t_117:0.en:
$$シン$$
「You who preach love, don't take lives! Everyone lives their own life and loves someone!」

671:t_117:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A Wingless's love means nothing to me. It was never even worth my notice.」

671:t_117:2.en:
$$シン$$
「You...! You think only your own feelings count as love!?」

671:t_117:3.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't let a guy like that destroy this world! We'll stop your twisted love!」

671:t_118:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Feelings alone or power alone can't accomplish anything...」

671:t_118:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「But your feelings are self-absorbed, and they're sending that power out of control!」

671:t_118:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A presumptuous Wingless denies the existence of me, an $$天翅$$?」

671:t_118:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「No one has the right to deny another's life...! But if you're going to take someone's life... and for your own convenience...!」

671:t_118:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「I won't hesitate to fight! That is my resolve!」

671:t_129:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you hadn't meddled, the $$時の牢獄$$ would have been completed, and that blue planet might have been protected.」

671:t_129:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But that would mean handing over humanity's future in exchange...! People rejected it!」

671:t_129:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「That is why we fight! Against those who block the future!」

671:t_129:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How foolish, Wingless... You don't even know how deep the darkness of the future of despair you're heading into is...」

671:t_130:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have no obligation to be pitied by the likes of a Wingless.」

671:t_130:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Love toyed with you, defeated you, and now you thrash about in its labyrinth...」

671:t_130:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you truly knew the meaning of love, at the very least you wouldn't have ended up hating anyone.」

671:t_130:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

671:t_130:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You are who I used to be...! That is why I'll cleanse that karma with my own hands!」

671:t_131:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed... Attack objective: the Black $$アクエリオン$$.」

671:t_131:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You dare come at these Wings of Darkness...! Then I will give you despair!」

671:t_131:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll tell you this. We shook that off long ago, and we're here now.」

671:t_131:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「There are people who believe in us... That gives me the strength to overcome despair.」

671:t_132:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hold on, $$ランカ$$! I'll save you right now!」

671:t_132:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why can't you understand that the more you reach out, the more that girl gets hurt?」

671:t_132:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$ has wings that can fly over that! I believe in them!」

671:t_132:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Her song! Her song is her feelings themselves, and it's hope!」

671:t_132:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「As long as she has it, she won't sink into despair! So all I have to do is fight to save her!!」

671:t_132:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then come. I'll make you see whether your hope or my despair is stronger!」

671:t_132:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sing, $$ランカ$$! Your voice and your feelings will bring hope into being!」

671:t_132:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll protect your song! That's my fight!」

671:t_133:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Spit out everything you feel! Hatred, sorrow, pain, suffering, all of it!!」

671:t_133:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who spin the power of life! You'd hurl that power at me!?」

671:t_133:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's have a session! If my song and your song become one, something new is bound to be born!」

671:t_133:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What is this guy...! He's different from the other Wingless somehow!」

671:t_133:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Sing, $$ミカゲ$$! And listen to my so-o-o-ong!!」

671:t_134:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Answer me! Is hurting people like this what you call the feeling of love!?」

671:t_134:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't understand love...! But watching $$アマタ$$ and the others, I can tell it's something wonderful!」

671:t_134:3.en:
$$レド$$
「But you're different! You say love, yet you're trying to wrap everyone around you... no, everything in unhappiness!」

671:t_134:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So what? I don't care whether the Wingless world is destroyed or what becomes of it.」

671:t_134:5.en:
$$レド$$
「...As I thought. What you call love must be wrong somehow!」

671:t_134:6.en:
$$レド$$
「And you, spreading your selfish desires like that, are my enemy!」

671:t_135:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems the feeling of love I know and your love are different kinds of things.」

671:t_135:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Naturally. Talking about an $$天翅$$ and a Wingless on the same level is out of the question.」

671:t_135:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「As I thought. Your love, which only makes others unhappy, is hard for humans to understand.」

671:t_135:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Believe it or not, I've learned how wonderful loving someone is! Someone who knows that wouldn't do something this destructive, even if love had defeated them!」

671:t_135:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Therefore, I will eliminate you here!」

671:t_136:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Successor. Knowing the future of despair, you still go on?」

671:t_136:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes! But we won't let the future be wrapped in despair!」

671:t_136:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We're fighting to make it a future full of light!」

671:t_136:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A futile struggle...! You can't beat them!」

671:t_136:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But a man who gave in to despair and abandoned his own future couldn't beat even us.」

671:t_136:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You do nothing but aim that rage at the world. You're a loser who looked away from the future!」

671:t_136:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We won't lose to someone like that! We'll show you that right now!」

671:t_137:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I can understand how you feel...」

671:t_137:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Wingless! Do you mean to pity me!?」

671:t_137:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「But I don't intend to accept you.」

671:t_137:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If you're going to end this world, I'll fight you.」

671:t_138:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't mind staking everything on love, but you're spreading your misdirected grudge and taking it out on everyone way too far!」

671:t_138:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What does a Wingless know about me!」

671:t_138:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Rejecting others like that is why you can't see what's around you! Open your heart a little more!」

671:t_138:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Love and hatred may be two sides of the same coin, but in your case, hatred has twisted even your love!」

671:t_138:5.en:
$$桂$$
「He won't listen...! Then it can't be helped!」

671:t_138:6.en:
$$桂$$
「If that's how it is, I'll stop you by force! Think of it as tough love, Mr. Heartbroken $$堕天翅$$!」

671:t_139:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you know the meaning of loving someone, how can you take away someone's happiness!?」
